capabilities: Display notes as map markers matching base filters
Style markers with icons and colors from properties
Load custom background tile URLs or style URLs
Configure center coordinates, default zoom, and zoom limits
disambiguation: Not a standalone map app or navigation tool; it is only a Bases view type for notes that already have coordinate properties.
extras: Full documentation, examples, tips, and troubleshooting are hosted on the Obsidian Help site rather than in the README.
intentEvidence: Adds a map layout to Obsidian Bases so you can display notes as an interactive map view.
problem: Bases views cannot show notes that have geographic coordinates as a map, so location-based notes have no visual, filterable map representation in the vault.

relations.evidence: Maps use OpenFreeMap tiles by default.

summary: A Bases layout that displays notes as markers on an interactive map, with icons, colors, and positions driven by note properties and filters.
